note: Criteria written from each description alone, before any implementation was seen.

cases.description: `Request.max_content_length` can be customized per-request instead of only through the `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` config. Added `MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE` and `MAX_FORM_PARTS` config.

criteria.name: a request can be given its own limit
criteria.check:
import flask
app = flask.Flask(__name__)
with app.test_request_context('/'):
    flask.request.max_content_length = 123
    assert flask.request.max_content_length == 123

criteria.name: the config is the default when nothing is set
criteria.check:
import flask
app = flask.Flask(__name__)
app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] = 456
with app.test_request_context('/'):
    assert flask.request.max_content_length == 456

criteria.name: the two new config keys exist and reach the request
criteria.check:
import flask
app = flask.Flask(__name__)
app.config['MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE'] = 7
app.config['MAX_FORM_PARTS'] = 8
with app.test_request_context('/'):
    assert flask.request.max_form_memory_size == 7
    assert flask.request.max_form_parts == 8

cases.description: `template_filter`, `template_test`, and `template_global` decorators can be used without parentheses.

criteria.name: an app decorator works without parentheses
it still works with parentheses and a name
the blueprint form works without parentheses too
criteria.check:
import flask
bp = flask.Blueprint('b', __name__)
@bp.app_template_global
def nine():
    return 9
app = flask.Flask(__name__)
app.register_blueprint(bp)
assert app.jinja_env.globals['nine']() == 9

criteria.name: an encoding can be given in text mode
criteria.check:
import flask, pathlib, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
pathlib.Path(d, 'x.txt').write_text('火腿', encoding='utf-16-le')
app = flask.Flask(__name__, root_path=d)
with app.open_resource('x.txt', mode='rt', encoding='utf-16-le') as f:
    assert f.read() == '火腿'

criteria.name: binary mode still works and takes no encoding
criteria.check:
import flask, pathlib, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
pathlib.Path(d, 'x.bin').write_bytes(b'\x00\x01')
app = flask.Flask(__name__, root_path=d)
with app.open_resource('x.bin') as f:
    assert f.read() == b'\x00\x01'

criteria.name: the blueprint form takes it as well
criteria.check:
import flask, pathlib, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
pathlib.Path(d, 'y.txt').write_text('ok', encoding='utf-8')
bp = flask.Blueprint('b', __name__, root_path=d)
with bp.open_resource('y.txt', mode='rt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    assert f.read() == 'ok'
